```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.show='hold'}
library(ggmap)
library(grid)

# Plot the map
ggmap(params$map) +
  geom_point(aes(x = `r st_coordinates(params$map)[1]`, y = `r st_coordinates(params$map)[2]`), color = 'red', size = 4) +
  ggtitle("Location on Map")
